appliesTo: any element that should be queried
summary: Turns an element into a query container, so its descendants can respond to its size.
details: Media queries look at the viewport; container queries look at the nearest ancestor with a container-type. Write @container (min-width: 400px) { … } in your CSS and the rules apply when that container is wide enough, wherever the component is placed.

values.note: Query width and height; the box can no longer size itself from its content.

gotcha: The container gets size containment, so it cannot grow to fit its children along the queried axis. Give it a width from its parent (a grid track, a flex item or an explicit width).
